explanation: Spandana (2019) is the one-stop public grievance redressal platform for the citizens of AP; CPGRAMS is the Union platform and Prajavani the earlier Collectorate portal.

notes.text: - "Web-based grievance system at Collectorates" = **Prajavani**; "one-stop grievance platform for AP citizens" = **Spandana**; **CPGRAMS** is the Union platform, not AP's.

exam: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
q: Which of the following is an e-Governance initiative of Andhra Pradesh which is a web based system of on-line receival, replying and monitoring of Public Grievances at District Collectorates?
explanation: Prajavani is the web-based system for online receipt, reply and monitoring of public grievances at District Collectorates; MeeSeva is a service centre and Arogyasri a health scheme.

notes.text: - "Web-based grievance system at Collectorates" = **Prajavani**; "one-stop grievance platform for AP citizens" = **Spandana**; **CPGRAMS** is the Union platform, not AP's.

exam: APPSC
q: What is the main purpose of a Citizen’s Charter in governance?
options: Provide time-bound service delivery and grievance redress
key_text: Provide time-bound service delivery and grievance redress
explanation: A Citizens' Charter is a written commitment on service standards whose main purpose is time-bound service delivery and grievance redress; the other options are unrelated.

notes.text: - A **written commitment** on service standards; main purpose = **time-bound service delivery and grievance redress**.

exam: APPSC Assistant Director in AP Economic & Statistics General
q: What is the name of alternate grievance redressal system established by many agencies like Tax, Banks and Insurance for resolution of complaints?
explanation: Tax departments, banks and insurers use an Ombudsman (e.g. Banking/Insurance Ombudsman) as the alternate grievance redress system; consumer courts are judicial fora.

notes.text: - Ombudsman = **Sweden, 1809**; banks, insurance and tax departments use an **Ombudsman** as the alternate grievance redress system for complaints (Banking/Insurance/Tax Ombudsman).

q: Before the enactment of the RTI Act, 2005, which Indian state was the first to introduce a Right to Information law?
explanation: Tamil Nadu enacted the first State RTI law in 1997 (Goa the same year), before the national RTI Act 2005; Rajasthan (2000), Karnataka (2000) and Maharashtra (2002) came later.
